nodes.label: Data-Driven Renderer Changes
nodes.rationale: Preserve Java game assets and bytecode behavior; prefer compatibility fixes in runtime APIs, texture decoding, projection, sorting, and rasterization; add diagnostics before optimizing; verify every rendering change with 3d_treasuretowers.jar and at least one non-MascotCapsule MIDP game.

nodes.label: Non-Power-of-Two Texture Padding
nodes.rationale: Non-power-of-two textures are padded to the next power of two before UV sampling to match old phone implementations.

nodes.label: Palette Index 0 Transparency
nodes.rationale: Palette index 0 is used as the transparent background for color-keyed and detected decal-like geometry.
